map.尿常规干化学结果判读器 使用指南: Urinalysis Dry Chemistry Result Interpreter — User Guide
map.尿常规干化学判读器，输入11项结果自动判读临床意义，辅助泌尿系统与代谢异常筛查。: A urinalysis dry-chemistry interpreter that automatically interprets the clinical meaning of 11 entered results, aiding urinary tract and metabolic abnormality screening.
map.体检尿常规异常项（如蛋白+、潜血+）组合理解可能方向。: Understand the possible directions of abnormal urinalysis items (e.g. protein+, blood+) as a set.
map.尿路感染提示（白细胞酯酶+亚硝酸盐）初筛。: Urinary tract infection screening (leukocyte esterase + nitrite).
map.教学演示条目间关联（如酮体+糖提示糖尿病酮症可能）。: Teaching demo of associations between items (e.g. ketones + glucose suggesting possible diabetic ketoacidosis).
map.：亚硝酸盐+ 且白细胞酯酶+，工具提示尿路感染可能，建议尿培养；若仅潜血+需结合: : nitrite+ and leukocyte esterase+ prompt a possible urinary tract infection and suggest urine culture; if only blood+ is positive, it needs to be combined with microscopy red cells.
map.不一定，肌红/血红蛋白也可假阳性；需镜检看红细胞确认。: Not necessarily—myoglobin/hemoglobin can also give false positives; confirm with microscopy red cells.
map.一过性可由运动/发热引起，持续需查肾；定量以 24h 或尿蛋白肌酐比为准。: A transient result can come from exercise or fever; persistent needs kidney investigation; quantification follows 24h urine or the protein-to-creatinine ratio.
map.不能，干化学仅筛查，确诊靠镜检、培养与临床。: No. Dry chemistry only screens; diagnosis relies on microscopy, culture and clinical findings.
